name: hang-loyalty
description: Integrate the Hang Loyalty partner API (points ledger + rewards) into your codebase — bundles the hang-loyalty MCP server, the integration skill, and a project rule.

HANG_API_KEY.title: Hang program API key
HANG_API_KEY.description: Program-scoped X-API-KEY. Sent as the MCP bearer token. Keep it secret.

HANG_PORTAL_BYPASS_TOKEN.title: Portal protection bypass token
HANG_PORTAL_BYPASS_TOKEN.description: Vercel Deployment Protection bypass for owner.hang.com. Get it from https://owner.hang.com/mcp

HANG_ACTIVITY_TYPE_ID.title: Default activity type id
HANG_ACTIVITY_TYPE_ID.description: Optional. Default earning activity type for earning tools (also accepted per-call).

HANG_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY.title: Enterprise API key
HANG_ENTERPRISE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Account-level key for /v2/enterprise/* provisioning tools only.
